remainingExecution: Run after exact verified staging release with explicit load scope; 12/25/50/100/125 steps and five independent member-complete/member-leave/replay rounds.
independentReview: Fresh-scope review completed; live provider-health binding and in-flight cleanup drain corrected before execution.
functionalRaceScope: Five fresh editions: 4+5 persons with different comfort preferences; two distinct account scans with distinct command IDs, then complete/leave race and independent replay.
replaySemantics: Immutable command result; current snapshot is reprojected at replay. Assertions compare result and one effect, never require an obsolete snapshot to remain current.
